$comment: What every SDK must do with each recorded fixture in rest/ and ws/. Maintained by hand: a newly recorded fixture needs an entry here, and each SDK's replay tests fail without one. REST: ok = the SDK method for that operation (spec/mapping.json, matched by method and path) returns the response parsed, with the X-Request-Id as its request ID; error = it raises that class (Dart adds the Exception suffix) carrying the status, the API's errorMessage and the request ID. Some recordings send what an SDK's API can't (an unknown field, a non-JSON body, a generic content type, a missing required argument, an unsupported value): there the replay sends the closest call the SDK can make and checks the response handling in full. WS: requests maps the recorded requestIds to each synthesis's outcome (completed, cancelled, superseded, failed:<class>, lost:<class>); session_error is the error that ends the session, raised directly or as the cause of the error a later call raises; handshake_error is the error connect raises; pong means a ping is answered; transcripts counts transcript events; ended is the session.ended reason; saved means a session.saved event with a job ID (its status can be "empty" when nothing was transcribed); events lists what the caller sees, in order, whether it arrives on the session's event stream or is raised by the call that caused it (a rejected terminology update is raised by set_terminology / setTerminology). A note explains anything a replay can't do the way the recording did.

stt/audio_before_started.note: the server accepts audio sent before session.started, but an SDK's connect returns only after session.started, so a replay delivers it first

stt/auto_cut.note: the server cuts a segment at 15 s without end_segment

stt/empty_and_tiny_segments.note: empty and very short segments produce no transcript

stt/fifo_order.note: transcripts arrive in the order their segments were cut

stt/frame_too_large.note: the SDKs split audio into frames of at most 64 KiB, so they never send this frame; replay the server's error and 1008 close

stt/handshake_missing_language.note: the SDKs always send a language; a replay sends an empty one and expects the server's 400

stt/ping.note: the recording's session.started arrived after the client's stop; an SDK's connect waits for session.started, so a replay delivers it first

stt/terminology.note: an invalid terminology update is rejected without ending the session

tts/binary_frame.note: the SDK never sends binary on the TTS stream; replay the server's error and 1008 close

tts/cancel_before_start.note: charged: the cancelled event reports creditsConsumed

tts/cancel_mid_stream.note: audio after the cancel is dropped, never delivered

tts/cancel_while_idle.note: the SDK sends no cancel when nothing is in flight, and nothing is expected back

tts/drop_mid_stream.note: charge state yes: audio had started

tts/invalid_json.note: the SDK never sends invalid JSON; replay the server's error and 1008 close

tts/invalid_while_running.note: the SDK cancels r1 itself once r2 is rejected, because the caller asked r1 to stop; the recorded server never saw that cancel and finished r1, which still ends as superseded and charged

tts/unknown_field.note: the unknown field can only be sent through extra_body / extraBody
